channel.desc: Kuala Lumpur, the capital of Malaysia, is a major urban center with a population of 2 million. Malaysia achieved independence from Britain in 1957. Following this, the Malaysian government promoted modern city development by rapidly constructing highways and housing, as well as implementing policies to nurture domestic industries. The country's economic growth continues through industrialization, such as transforming former oil palm plantations into factory sites and establishing hubs for the IT industry.
